scope: Documentation-review phase: a versioned workspace-provider profile contract with fixtures and an evaluation of Archil's documented behavior against the projected-workspace contract. No Archil account, credential, disk, sandbox, adapter or network call.
immediate_outcome: A declared provider profile that relies on a documented-insufficient mechanism, or claims qualification from a vendor claim or fixture, is refused for its own reason; the evaluation retains Archil as a reference and names branch-per-attempt isolation on a disposable managed flat-block disk as the one mechanism worth qualifying for unrestricted profiles.
durable_capability: config/workspace-provider-profile.ncl (kiln.workspace-provider-profile.v1), its fixtures and tests/workspace-provider-profile.sh in the nickel Nix check.
ordering: The proposal, design and tasks gates were first run after the contract and fixtures were drafted; they passed without changes to the package.

checks.result: pass: three positive profiles export; ten negative profiles are each refused with their own reason
pass (88 positive, 608 negative) after nickel format
pass: Nickel fixture gate (88 positive, 608 negative) and the profile refusal test

evidence_classes.vendor_claim: Every Archil capability in docs/archil-workspace-evaluation.md, from Archil documentation checked 2026-11-17
evidence_classes.deterministic_fixture: The local baseline profile and the contract fixtures

remaining: Shared corpus and local baseline through the projected materializer (#78).
Operator-run live Archil phase in a disposable environment with named time, resource, cost and retention bounds.
non_claims: The profile contract checks declared capabilities, not provider behavior.
Vendor latency, durability and isolation figures are not Kiln measurements.
No provider is adopted and no default changes.
